flight_unlocks.mechanics: Innate Elytra state plus small continuous server-authoritative forward thrust while fall-flying, preserving vanilla aerodynamic control. No hovering/vertical creative free flight; intended to overcome passive drag and reward skillful pitch.

flight_unlocks.mechanics: True hovering creative-style flight; independent of external Draconic Curio module and validated against other flight providers.

Harbinger and Ignis tier materials or direct boss proof; align Eldritch Ancient Miner
validated Chaos Guardian defeat, no bypass via recipes or ProjectE

world_tier_milestones.condition: Guardian defeated; normal pack ProjectE/Project Expansion system unlock still applies

critical_paths: Unarmed empty-hand harvesting must emulate the correct tool mining tier and drops without removing boss/ore gates
At least one before-Guardian non-weapon projectile or damaging spell path must work on Guardian crystals and shield
Dragon encounter must be survivable before innate glide unlock (Curio, spell, conventional building, or existing pre-Dragon mobility); never circularly require gliding to unlock gliding
End portal, Nether material acquisition, Deeper/Darker and boss arena travel cannot require wearing conventional armor or swinging a regular weapon
Allow Curios including Draconic chestpiece body Curio; never treat that as disallowed conventional armor if worn in Curio slot
Boss kills using qualified spells, summons, projectiles or unarmed hits must count; attribution and party-credit policy to decide
World tier evidence is checked server-side at time of spending and never deduced solely from an FTB quest claim
ProjectE/Expansion must stay inaccessible until Chaos Guardian regardless of Monk rank or items

Audit Draconic and Chaotic Flight modules: source grants Creative Flight before any Monk skill; if those modules are available pre-Chaos, their Curio functionality bypasses the intended gate. Do not disallow Curios; gate effective Creative mode at the pack tier.
attribution_policy: pending exact owner decision on personal versus team participation; design must avoid repeatability exploits and unearned global world unlock

known_bypass_risk.preferred_mitigation: central pack-wide creative flight tier gate after Chaos Guardian
